specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone Battle of Gods SCYTHE weapon design preview for owner approval. Coarse clean fantasy pixel art matching compact King: crisp chunky charcoal perimeter, bright ivory/silver steel edge, controlled graphite planes, minimal readable shading, nearest-neighbor enlarged visible square pixels. Flat dark blue-charcoal background, centered entire weapon with ample blank margin around all tips and pommel. Long shaft and hooked inward cutting blade; no axe, spear or straight sword substitution. No characters, no scenery, no UI, no glow, no golden ornament, no skulls, no tiny illegible filigree. This is concept-only, no animation, no existing runtime change. One large weapon and one small same-design inventory silhouette below it. Design A: IRON REAPER. A clearly angular hooked reaper head, broad silver cutting edge with a clipped shoulder and a sharply downturned long pointed tip. Strong iron socket, long dark straight wood shaft with a SHORT crimson wrap at grip and a simple iron pommel. A practical powerful silhouette, blade about one third of the shaft height, no enormous guard. The upper counterweight is short and compact. Text at top exactly 'A · IRON REAPER'.
